## Biography

The Clan of Redonesses is a lawless criminal faction that firmly controls the Redonesses system. In September 3312, the missing Independent Detention Foundation prison ship EVE-597 was discovered drifting and damaged within the Clan's territory, raising questions about possible involvement between the clan and the vessel's arrival.
